d:
This gallery serves to archive a variety of English-translated and typesetted (by yours truly) Uma Musume works. Most of these were requests from the /uma/ General thread on 4chan's /vg/ board.

Some of these images have also been posted on Reddit under the username u/FourCheeseWhopper

Should you have any request for translation and typeset, feel free to request in the uma general on /vg/.

This gallery will be continously updated.
n: [Non-H] Random English Translated Uma Musume Works
